title: Decision of the AI Office
summary: The AI Office has issued a formal decision outlining the approved use of artificial intelligence within the organization. The policy specifies the scope of permissible AI applications, the required safeguards, and the responsibilities of staff for compliance.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Technology Specialists in AI
summary: This document announces a vacancy for technology specialists in the AI office. It outlines the qualifications and responsibilities expected of candidates to support AI projects within the organization.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Lead Scientific Adviser
summary: This document announces a vacancy for the position of Lead Scientific Adviser within the AI office. It outlines the role’s responsibilities, required qualifications, and the application process for prospective candidates.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Legal Officers
summary: This policy outlines how to fill vacancies in AI-related offices with qualified legal officers. It sets out the eligibility requirements, duties, and the procedure for selecting and appointing those officers.

title: AI Office Vacancy: Policy Officers
summary: The policy explains how to fill vacant positions for AI policy officers, detailing who can apply, how candidates are selected, and what duties the role will cover. It also sets out expectations for training, performance reviews, and collaboration with other teams to ensure consistent AI governance.

title: AI Act Scientific Panel
summary: The AI Act Scientific Panel is a group of experts convened to review and advise on the European Union’s AI legislation. They assess the technical, ethical, and societal impacts of AI systems to help shape rules that promote safe, transparent, and responsible use of artificial intelligence.

title: Draft Standardisation Request
summary: This document outlines a request to create standardized guidelines and protocols for AI development and deployment. It aims to promote consistency, safety, and ethical considerations across the industry by establishing common standards.

title: CoP Consultation Notice
summary: This notice announces a consultation process for establishing or updating a Community of Practice related to AI. It invites stakeholders to provide input and outlines the next steps for the consultation.

title: CoP Call for Expression of Interest
summary: The document announces a call for people to express interest in a Community of Practice (CoP). It invites individuals to register their willingness to participate and outlines the next steps for joining.

title: CoP Graphic: Overview of Iterative Drafting Process
summary: The document presents a visual guide that explains the iterative drafting process for developing AI policy, showing how drafts are repeatedly reviewed and refined. It outlines the main steps, key stakeholders, and feedback loops that help ensure the final policy is comprehensive and well‑considered.

title: CoP Graphic: Timeline of Drafting Process
summary: This document shows a graphic timeline of the drafting process for the Community of Practice, marking when each phase started and finished. It helps members see how the policy evolved over time and identify key milestones.

title: Code of Practice: 1st Draft
summary: The Code of Practice: 1st Draft presents a set of foundational guidelines intended to govern AI development and deployment. It emphasizes transparency, accountability, and the management of potential risks to ensure ethical and safe AI practices.

title: Code of Practice: 2nd Draft
summary: The document outlines guidelines for responsible AI use, setting out principles and requirements that developers and organizations should follow to act ethically, transparently, and safely. It notes that this is the second draft, indicating that the guidelines are still evolving and may be updated as more insight is gained.

title: Code of Practice: 3rd Draft
summary: This document presents the third draft of a Code of Practice that sets out principles for responsible use of AI, emphasizing transparency, fairness, and accountability. It aims to provide clear, actionable guidelines that align with industry standards and improve the overall trustworthiness of AI systems.

title: AI Pact Draft
summary: The AI Pact Draft proposes a cooperative framework to guide the responsible creation and use of artificial intelligence. It urges governments, industry, and civil society to agree on shared standards for safety, transparency, and accountability in AI systems.

title: AI Pact Final
summary: The AI Pact Final outlines commitments and principles for responsible AI development and deployment. It establishes guidelines, accountability mechanisms, and collaboration among stakeholders to ensure AI technologies benefit society while mitigating risks.

title: Guidelines on prohibited artificial intelligence (AI) practices
summary: The guidelines specify which AI activities are forbidden, such as those that could cause harm, breach privacy, or manipulate public opinion, and outline the standards organizations must meet to avoid them. By giving clear examples and compliance measures, the document helps entities identify and steer clear of disallowed AI applications.

title: Guidelines on AI System Definition
summary: The document outlines how organizations should define and categorize AI systems for compliance and risk management purposes. It provides criteria and examples for identifying what constitutes an AI system, ensuring consistent reporting and oversight across different applications.

title: Communication on Boosting Start-Ups & Innovation
summary: This policy outlines strategies to enhance communication for start‑ups and foster innovation. It proposes initiatives such as networking events, mentorship programs, and funding opportunities to support new businesses.

title: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups
summary: EuroHPC Initiative for Start-Ups aims to support emerging companies by providing access to high-performance computing resources, financial incentives, and training programs across Europe. The policy encourages startups to develop AI and data‑intensive solutions through collaboration with research institutions and industry partners, fostering innovation and accelerating market readiness.

title: Slideshow: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: This document outlines the key components of a webinar focused on risk management, including objectives, agenda, and participant engagement strategies. It also provides guidance on how to structure the slideshow, capture attendee feedback, and document key takeaways for future reference.

title: Video: Webinar on Risk Management
summary: A video webinar that explores risk management, covering how to identify, evaluate, and mitigate potential risks in projects. It discusses best practices, tools, and strategies for managing uncertainties to improve project outcomes.
